correctness.rationale: The expectation is of the Jaccard ratio on detected species, not individual overlap or a ratio of expectations. Inclusion–exclusion counts exactly those size-m subsets whose support is S, and independence multiplies two support counts. A separate replay generated every composition via cuts among N−1 gaps, sorted to exhaust the abundance partitions, and averaged the rational similarity over every ordered pair of labeled size-m samples. It agrees with the frozen CSV on all 135 cells of all 29 profiles through N=6. Its only strict drop is (1,5) from 7/9 to 3/4, at m=2 to 3. For general (1,N−1), both m≥2 samples always include the dominant species, so a similarity loss of 1/2 occurs precisely on singleton detection disagreement. Under independence the disagreement probability is 2(m/N)(1−m/N); under disjoint sampling the singleton cannot appear twice, giving 2m/N. At m=1 the ratio is exactly the species-match indicator. The initial increase is 2/N² and the forward difference thereafter is (2m+1−N)/N², which also gives the asserted integer minimizers on the stated domain (including the odd-N tie when both nearest integers are in it). Analytic arguments, not extrapolation, support the arbitrary-N results.
residual_risks: Finite classification is through N=6 only; the analytical larger-census law is for the singleton/dominant family. Disjoint designs require 2m≤N.

checked_sources: Wolda 1981 and Chao et al. 2005 for the scientific motivation
value.rationale: The sharp obstruction answers whether expected within-community Jaccard can serve as a monotone diagnostic of greater sampling effort under a standard finite sampling design. Smallest-census uniqueness is a natural endpoint, not an selected profile after the fact. The two protocols preserve equal marginal effort but differ in how singleton detections pair, reaching a 1/4 expectation gap at half the census; this gives the phenomenon quantitative and design relevance.
residual_risks: Idealized perfect detection of uniform finite subsets; no direct guarantee about field sampling or observed individual realizations.
